explication:
## Purpose and Runtime
DAVx⁵ is a native Android/Kotlin application for CalDAV/CardDAV synchronization, task sync, and live WebDAV file access through Android’s Storage Access Framework. The main product module is `core`; `app-ose` supplies open-source-edition application/flavor wiring. Gradle builds the multi-module Android project via `settings.gradle.kts` and `build.gradle.kts`.

## Application Entry and Composition
Android starts the app from manifests, then application classes initialize the shared core and OSE-specific layer. Dependency injection modules bind application variants, sync infrastructure, startup plugins, logging, and security integrations.
- `core/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/CoreApp.kt`
- `app-ose/src/main/kotlin/com/davx5/ose/App.kt`

## UI, Account Setup, and Authentication
Compose-based Activities/ViewModels expose account management, setup, collection selection, settings, push, and WebDAV mount screens. Login supports conventional URL/email discovery plus provider-specific Nextcloud, Google, and Fastmail OAuth flows. UI is a boundary over repositories and Android account/sync services.
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/ui/setup/LoginActivity.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/ui/setup/LoginScreenViewModel.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/network/OAuthIntegration.kt`

## Remote Discovery, Network, and Security
Service detection discovers DAV principals, home sets, and collections, persisting discovered server topology for account setup and later refresh. HTTP construction, DNS resolution, OAuth, client certificates, certificate security contexts, and Conscrypt integration form the network/security boundary to remote DAV servers.
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/servicedetection/DavResourceFinder.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/servicedetection/ServiceRefresher.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/network/HttpClientBuilder.kt`

## Persistent Account and Service State
Room-backed `AppDatabase` stores DAV accounts, services, principals, home sets, collections, sync statistics, and WebDAV mount/document metadata. DAO-backed repositories insulate UI, discovery, sync, and provider code from storage. Schema history makes database migrations a compatibility boundary.
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/db/AppDatabase.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/repository/AccountRepository.kt`
- `core/schemas/at.bitfire.davdroid.db.AppDatabase/20.json`

## Synchronization Orchestration
Android AccountManager/SyncAdapter and WorkManager entry points schedule and execute periodic or one-time sync. `SyncManager` selects domain-specific syncers for calendars, contacts, tasks, and JTX notes; these reconcile remote DAV resources with local Android provider state, validate conditions, record results, and notify users. Push registrations/messages can trigger or complement refresh behavior.
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/sync/adapter/SyncAdapterImpl.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/sync/SyncManager.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/sync/worker/SyncWorkerManager.kt`

## Local Data and Format Translation
`resource` adapts app sync logic to local calendar, contacts, tasks, and JTX stores. The separate `synctools` Android library performs iCalendar/vCard parsing/generation and maps protocol objects to Android content-provider entities, including recurrence and provider-specific task/JTX contracts.
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/resource/LocalCalendarStore.kt`
- `synctools/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/synctools/icalendar/ICalendarParser.kt`
- `synctools/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/synctools/mapping/contacts/ContactWriter.kt`

## WebDAV Documents Provider
A distinct Storage Access Framework path exposes configured WebDAV mounts as Android documents. `DavDocumentsProvider` delegates browse/read/write/move operations to WebDAV operations, maintains database metadata, and uses disk/thumbnail caches for file access.
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/webdav/DavDocumentsProvider.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/webdav/WebDavMountRepository.kt`
- `core/src/main/kotlin/at/bitfire/davdroid/webdav/operation/OpenDocumentOperation.kt`
